spec.description: AcoustiFlex SQ flexible noise barrier and vibration damping material has a soft, cellular structure that increases vibration dampening to achieve superior Sound Transmission Loss (STL) for a given weight and thickness [1]. It consists of a flexible micro-cellular membrane bonded to an aluminium facing foil with a reinforced polyester backing [1]. Certified by the CSIRO Division of Materials Science and Engineering as Group 1 Fire Rated, it provides high sound attenuation across the full frequency spectrum [1].
features: Low VOCs (Less than a recognised threshold of 0.5mg 'Green Star') [1]
Easy to handle, cut and install [1]
Available in different weights (other configurations available on request) [1]
Soft and cellular structure increases vibration dampening [1]
Matching acoustic performance of equivalent heavier competitive noise barriers [1]
applications: ceilings and roofs against overhead aircraft noise and rain [1]
external walls and ceilings against traffic, train and neighbour noise [1]
home theatres, entertainment areas and machinery rooms [1]
offices, meeting rooms, doctors and lawyers consulting rooms [1]
construction site temporary fencing acoustic barriers [1]

technical.value: AcoustiFlex SQ 25: Rw 24; SQ 40: Rw 28; SQ 60: Rw 35; SQ 80: Rw 36

spec.fire: Group 1 Fire Rated (certified by CSIRO Division of Materials Science and Engineering) [1]
spec.sustainability: Low VOCs (less than the recognised Green Star threshold of 0.5 mg/m²/hr); Environmentally safe (no protective wear required); Australian Made certified [1]
install: Treat installation the same way as a waterproof membrane or traditional sarking material [1]
Lay AcoustiFlex SQ aluminium facing up [1]
Hang loose over supports rather than tight [1]
Tape all joints on the aluminium side with reinforced 72mm wide aluminium tape [1]
Nail or staple through to supports where necessary to prevent excessive deflection or sagging [1]
Where butt jointed at supports, ensure each sheet end is tightly fitted, nailed through to the support, and taped [1]
Fill floor/ceiling void between joists with acoustic or thermal insulation [1]
Ensure all electrical cabling is installed or relocated over the AcoustiFlex SQ by a qualified electrician [1]
selection_checklist: Confirm required sound transmission loss rating (Rw 24, 28, 35, or 36) [1]
Confirm installation type (roof, ceiling space, timber floor, or site fencing) [1]
Verify BCA Group 1 fire rating compliance for the space [1]
Calculate total area allowing for 75mm to 100mm overlaps [1]
Ensure an electrician is scheduled to relocate any existing wiring over the membrane [1]
limitations: Must be hung loose over supports rather than pulled tight [1]
All electrical cabling must be located above the membrane and never trapped beneath [1]
All joints must be overlapped by 75-100mm and taped on the aluminium side [1]

use_cases: draping across ceiling joists under metal deck roofs to mitigate aircraft and rain noise
installing inside drywall wall cavities for medical and legal privacy consulting rooms
hung as portable sound blankets or draped over temporary fencing on construction sites
damping machinery room noise transmission to adjoining residential spaces
not_for: direct impact footstep noise reduction under floorboards without resilient underlay
primary thermal insulation without bulk batts
direct external exposure without protective cladding or fencing tarp
retrieval.rag_summary: Acoustica Acoustiflex SQ is an Australian-made, high-performance flexible noise barrier and vibration-damping membrane featuring a micro-cellular structure bonded to an aluminium foil facing with reinforced backing. Achieving CSIRO Group 1 fire classification and airborne sound reduction up to Rw 36, it is engineered for roofs, ceilings, inter-tenancy walls, plant rooms, and construction site barriers. It effectively attenuates airborne noise, aircraft flyover noise, heavy rain impact on metal roofs, and speech privacy issues while meeting stringent NCC fire and low-VOC requirements.
